d: Sfor*zato, a. (Mus.) “Forcing or forced; -- a direction placed over a note, to signify that it must be executed with peculiar emphasis and force; -- marked fz (an abbreviation of forzando), sf, sfz, or”
w.e: It. sforzando, p. pr., and sforzato, p. p. of sforzare to force.

n: (music) a notation written above a note and indicating that it is to be played with a strong initial attack
